lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into at least four discernible vertical columns on the visible posterior flank section, with a wider inter-cluster spacing observed near the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure of high-luminance nodes on the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A well-defined horizontal ridge runs along the center of the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transitioning from high luminance on the dorsal side to a deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible posterior region of the first dorsal fin's silhouette exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily arranged in a vertical row of three nodes near the trailing margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits a series of approximately six high-luminance spots of varying diameters concentrated primarily along the leading edge; a remora-like organism is visible attached to the ventral posterior flank.
